name: The Spymaster's Ledger
about: The old spymaster dies, and his book of every lord's secrets goes missing. Whoever has it can push the great houses around. Find it first, then burn it or use it, and live with what the lords think you know.
title: The Spymaster's Ledger

beats.speaker: named
beats.text: The crown's old spymaster dies in his sleep, and his ledger is gone from his locked chest. It held every secret of every great house.

court.text: {named} of {named.house}, a little too carefully: "They say the old man kept a book, Your Grace. I hope the crown has it safe?"

options.label: Search the whole court for it (200 gold)
options.hint: the search begins · every lord gets nervous
options.result: The King's men search every chamber and saddlebag in Kingsmere. The great lords leave early.

options.label: Tell {named} the crown has it, and smile
options.result: The King says the ledger is safe. {named} goes very pale, and very polite.

options.label: Say there's no ledger, just an old man's boast
options.hint: nothing now · whoever has it can use it freely
options.result: The King laughs off the ledger. Somewhere, someone is reading it.

beats.speaker: thief
beats.text: Lords start voting, marrying and buying the way {thief} wants. {named} sells {thief} a town for almost nothing, and won't say why.

court.text: {named}, alone and quiet: "{thief} has the ledger, Your Grace. {thief.He} has my secrets, and half the realm's. Take it from {thief.him}, and I'm yours."

options.label: Send the King's men to search {hall}
options.hint: {thief.houseName} −30 · if it isn't there, you look like a tyrant
options.result: The King's men tear {hall} apart by torchlight.

options.label: Buy the ledger from {thief} (500 gold)
options.hint: {thief.houseName} +10 · the crown holds the realm's secrets
options.result: The ledger changes hands in a sept at midnight. Of course {thief} keeps a copy.

options.label: Wait for {thief} to go too far
options.hint: nothing now · the lords give way to {thief}
options.result: The King waits. Every week {thief} has more friends at court.

beats.speaker: thief
beats.text: With half the realm's secrets in {thief.his} hand, {thief} calls the great lords to {hall}, and they come. {thief} asks them why a King who knows nothing about them should rule them.

beats.speaker: named
beats.text: The crown has the old spymaster's ledger now. Every great lord knows it, so every great lord is suddenly very loyal, and very afraid.

court.text: {named}: "The ledger is yours, Your Grace. Will you use it, or burn it?"

options.label: Burn it in front of the court
options.hint: {named.houseName} +15 · {thief.houseName} −10, cheated of the sale · the crown gives up a weapon
options.result: The ledger burns in the great hall's fireplace. The lords breathe again, and some of them cheer.

options.label: Keep it, and let them wonder
options.hint: the lords obey quietly · every house holds a grudge
options.result: The ledger goes into the King's own chest. The court has never been so polite.

beats.speaker: named
beats.text: The ledger is ash, or locked in the crown's chest, and its secrets with it. The great houses go back to plotting the old way, out in the open.
